actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Draw ONE SINGLE complete BACK-VIEW adult Bunny, one centered full-body figure from head to soles in white portrait composition1024x1536. Absolutely one figure, no front view, no comparison panels, no duplicate body. Freshly draw the ENTIRE character in Japanese hand-ink + hard cel shading; do not crop a multi-person sheet or patch old art.
REF1 is the accepted SINGLE back figure: preserve its exact body/pose, clothing, orange jacket full opaque back/center seam/short rear hem, exposed narrow white inner-shirt strip, pants waist/loops/hip/crotch, all left/right gear, long legs, socks, shoe-back views. In BACK VIEW character LEFT is SCREEN LEFT: orange thigh-high sock, left sleeve functional pocket with small official white connected OG, fingerless left glove/orange wrist. Screen right white knee sock, black full glove/red wrist and thigh straps. Keep everything.
REF2 same-view BASE head is sole head identity/material authority, same scale as ref1: cool-gray continuous silver-white hair masses, dark ink contours, no fragmented white highlights or bright blue lines.
REF3 is ONLY accepted lower harness hook and waist belt configuration; preserve its 2 compact silver hooks/2 black rear anchor tabs and black belt threaded through original RED pants loops. No orange covers at back, no central buckle.
NEW LAYER ORDER: white shirt, then harness, then ORANGE JACKET OVER IT. All shoulder straps, upper back bridge and underbust rear ring are INSIDE jacket and FULLY HIDDEN. Orange shoulders and orange back must remain exactly plain cloth with center seam like REF1, no black H/vertical strips/outline/x-ray. No front lapels visible from rear.
ONLY add TWO short BLACK strap ends emerging from UNDER the short back hem, passing OVER the existing white inner-shirt strip and then the lower back to TWO silver hooks; each hook meets one ring on one sewn BLACK belt anchor. Keep existing white strip visible between/around those two tails. Belt sits on existing pants waistband; do not raise pants or jacket hem, widen waist, lengthen hooks, or pull garment down to reveal harness.
Maintain small OG shape/margin and visible black fine-rib collar/cuffs. Clean cel flat colors with sparse hard shadows, no white specks/mosaic/cloudy cloth or oily soft gradients. No text, no title, no other view or figure.

method: builtin imagegen; complete fresh drawing; byte-exact native; lossless WebP only
